package_info.package_name: Font Package (MSI) used by PDF editor app
package_info.why_malicious: The package was compromised to include a concealed cryptocurrency miner executable. When deployed as part of the PDF editor app, the miner was installed and executed with elevated privileges, resulting in unauthorized use of system CPU/GPU resources, potential system instability, and covert exfiltration of mined cryptocurrency to external mining pools.

execution_context.trigger: post-installation, during runtime of the PDF editor app
execution_context.file_location: Embedded executable within the MSI font package, extracted and launched by the PDF editor app process
required_permissions: filesystem (to extract and execute the miner binary)
network (to communicate with external mining pools)
elevated privileges (inherited from PDF editor app installer context)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious coinminer binary (the report describes a compiled executable hidden inside the MSI font package, which is extracted and executed post-installation; actual binary code not shown in the report)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime after installation, the code extracts a hidden coinminer executable from the MSI font package, launches it as a background process using inherited elevated privileges, establishes outbound network connections to cryptocurrency mining pools, and continuously consumes system CPU/GPU resources to mine cryptocurrency, resulting in unauthorized resource usage and covert exfiltration of mined currency.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code surreptitiously deploys and executes a coinminer binary without user knowledge or consent, leveraging the elevated privileges of the PDF editor app to maximize mining efficiency and evade detection.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Font packages are expected to contain only font files and related static resources, not hidden executables or code that launches persistent background processes. The presence of an embedded binary that is extracted and run post-installation is a clear violation of software packaging norms.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate software installers may include optional utilities or updaters, but these are always disclosed to the user, require explicit consent, and do not masquerade as font resources or execute hidden background processes.
key_indicators: MSI font package contains an embedded executable binary
Extraction and execution of a hidden process during or after installation
Background process exhibits high CPU/GPU usage unrelated to normal PDF or font operations
Outbound network connections to known cryptocurrency mining pool domains or IP addresses
Process inherits elevated privileges from the installer context

attack_chain.action: Threat actor compromises the cloud server infrastructure of the font package provider and injects a malicious coinminer executable into the MSI package.
attack_chain.leads_to: Distribution of the compromised MSI font package to downstream software vendors.

attack_chain.action: PDF editor app vendor downloads and integrates the compromised MSI font package into their product build pipeline.
attack_chain.leads_to: End users receive the tainted PDF editor app containing the malicious font package.

attack_chain.action: End user installs the PDF editor app, which includes the compromised MSI font package.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious coinminer code is present on the user's system.

attack_chain.action: At runtime, the malicious coinminer executable is extracted from the MSI font package and launched with system privileges, mining cryptocurrency using the user's CPU/GPU and establishing outbound connections to mining pools.
attack_chain.leads_to: Unauthorized resource usage, potential system instability, and covert exfiltration of mined cryptocurrency.

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected background processes launched by font or resource packages immediately after installation
Sustained high CPU/GPU usage following installation of non-resource-intensive applications such as PDF editors
Processes associated with the PDF editor or font package initiating outbound network connections to cryptocurrency mining pools
file_indicators: MSI font packages containing embedded executable binaries (e.g., .exe, .dll) in addition to expected font files
Unusual files or processes with names mimicking legitimate font resources but possessing executable characteristics
Presence of extracted executable files in temporary or application data directories after installation
network_indicators: Outbound connections from the PDF editor or font package processes to known cryptocurrency mining pool domains or IP addresses
Unexpected network activity (e.g., persistent TCP connections) initiated by processes not expected to require network access, such as font resource handlers
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Perform static analysis of MSI font packages to identify embedded executables. Monitor for new or unexpected processes launched by PDF editor or font package components post-installation. Track system resource usage for unexplained spikes in CPU/GPU utilization after installing non-resource-intensive software. Inspect network traffic for connections to known cryptocurrency mining pool endpoints originating from PDF editor or font package processes. Correlate the appearance of new executables or background processes with recent software installations to identify suspicious activity.
